Good to know

A clear start.
No surprises.

Is my website really free forever?

Yes. FIBODO Free includes your website and hosting at £0 per month. You can stay on the free plan for as long as you like.

Do I need a payment card to get started?

Yes, we require a card to prove your identity.

What’s included?

Your professional website, hosting, a bespoke URL, space to showcase your services and a findbookdo.com listing.

Are bookings and payments included?

Bookings, payments and additional business tools are available through paid upgrades. Start with your free website and add more only when you are ready.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Create your profile, add your services and publish your site. No code or complicated setup is required.
